newsitem.title: FRANCE: ONIC head sees total French grain crop at 60 mln T.
newsitem.headline: ONIC head sees total French grain crop at 60 mln T.

text.p: France is set to harvest a total grain crop of some 60 million tonnes in 1996, the director general of the French grain office ONIC predicted on Wednesday.

"Estimates for the total grain crop are of 60 million tonnes, a level that will match production levels of before the reform of the Common Agricultural Policy," Alain Moulinier told a news conference.
ONIC statistics put the last record grain crop at 60.5 million tonnes in 1992/93.
The farm ministry is expected soon to revise its estimate for the total 1996 grain crop to 61 million tonnes from a previous target of 57.3 million, grain industry sources said on Tuesday.
This would compare with 53.6 million tonnes of grain produced in 1995.
In a monthly supply/demand report distributed ahead of the news conference, ONIC put the 1996 grain harvest, excluding maize, at 45.97 million tonnes aagainst 40.26 million in 1995.
The estimate was based on data available in August and included soft wheat, durum wheat, barley, oats and triticale.
